title: Johan Sverdrup 海上油田

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Johan Sverdrup 海上油田案例中比較油藏物料與壓力與公開井筒屏障概念，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate reservoir material/pressure and public well-barrier concepts within the Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield case.

steps.title: 儲層模型與物料平衡：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reservoir models and material balance: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對油藏物料與壓力提出可反駁的儲層模型與物料平衡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir models and material balance model and evidence record for reservoir material/pressure.
steps.instruction: 在「Johan Sverdrup 海上油田」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識油藏物料與壓力。油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 建立儲層模型與物料平衡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是岸電、平臺整合與海底接回。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify reservoir material/pressure in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield. Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir models and material balance, focusing on shore power, platform integration and subsea tiebacks. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。
steps.observationEn: Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：地質資源數量等於可即時開採量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Geological resources equal immediately producible quantities.
steps.check: 提交油藏物料與壓力的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for reservoir material/pressure.

knowledge.title: 儲層模型與物料平衡
knowledge.text: 油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 本課架構對應：油藏物料與壓力
knowledge.textEn: Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources. Course architecture correspondence: Reservoir material/pressure

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；地質資源數量等於可即時開採量。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Geological resources equal immediately producible quantities.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假想一日液體進料1000 t，油700 t、水280 t、未判明20 t。質量閉合=98%，未判明2%須保留；不能把全部差額直接當洩漏，需核對取樣、庫存與量測。無實際井壓、鑽進或井控操作。
knowledge.textEn: Assume daily liquid feed 1000 t, oil 700 t, water 280 t and unassigned 20 t: closure 98%, unresolved 2%. Do not call the entire residual leakage; check samples, inventory and measurements. No well-pressure, drilling or well-control operations are provided.

quiz.question: 就油藏物料與壓力的「儲層模型與物料平衡」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for reservoir models and material balance in reservoir material/pressure?
options: 油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。
地質資源數量等於可即時開採量。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources.
Geological resources equal immediately producible quantities.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。
quiz.explanationEn: Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources. Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data.

steps.title: 儲層模型與物料平衡：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Reservoir models and material balance: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對油藏物料與壓力提出可反駁的儲層模型與物料平衡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir models and material balance model and evidence record for reservoir material/pressure.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「儲層模型與物料平衡」模型，檢查油藏物料與壓力的兩個假想案例。按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous reservoir models and material balance model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving reservoir material/pressure. Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。
steps.observationEn: Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：地質資源數量等於可即時開採量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Geological resources equal immediately producible quantities.
steps.check: 提交油藏物料與壓力的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for reservoir material/pressure.

steps.title: 井筒屏障與完整性：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Well barriers and integrity: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對公開井筒屏障概念提出可反駁的井筒屏障與完整性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable well barriers and integrity model and evidence record for public well-barrier concepts.
steps.instruction: 在「Johan Sverdrup 海上油田」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識公開井筒屏障概念。多個屏障路徑與監測共同支持完整性；概念課不提供鑽井或井控操作參數。 建立井筒屏障與完整性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是岸電、平臺整合與海底接回。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用原創功能圖區分承壓路徑與監測，不設計現場操作。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify public well-barrier concepts in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield. Multiple barriers/monitoring support integrity; conceptual courses supply no drilling or well-control settings. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well barriers and integrity, focusing on shore power, platform integration and subsea tiebacks. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate containment and monitoring in an original functional diagram without field operations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用原創功能圖區分承壓路徑與監測，不設計現場操作。
steps.observationEn: Separate containment and monitoring in an original functional diagram without field operations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一項井口量測足以證明所有地下屏障。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One wellhead measurement proves every subsurface barrier.
steps.check: 提交公開井筒屏障概念的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for public well-barrier concepts.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate oil/gas/water interfaces and subsea tiebacks/platforms within the Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield case.

steps.title: 多相輸送與壓降：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Multiphase transport and pressure drop: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對油氣水多相界面提出可反駁的多相輸送與壓降模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable multiphase transport and pressure drop model and evidence record for oil/gas/water interfaces.
steps.instruction: 在「Johan Sverdrup 海上油田」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識油氣水多相界面。氣液相分佈影響流動及設備負載；單相近似只適合指定假設。 建立多相輸送與壓降的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是岸電、平臺整合與海底接回。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify oil/gas/water interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield. Gas/liquid distributions affect flow/loading; single-phase approximations need bounded assumptions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of multiphase transport and pressure drop, focusing on shore power, platform integration and subsea tiebacks. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。
steps.observationEn: Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：油氣水混合流可不加說明地當作純水。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Oil/gas/water mixtures are indistinguishable from pure water without qualification.
steps.check: 提交油氣水多相界面的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.instructionEn: Use the previous multiphase transport and pressure drop model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving oil/gas/water interfaces. Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Gas/liquid distributions affect flow/loading; single-phase approximations need bounded assumptions." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：油氣水混合流可不加說明地當作純水。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw platform/subsea interfaces with environmental/service assumptions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Separation, compression and cooling use energy; shore power shifts some emissions without making lifecycle emissions zero. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of processing energy and emissions, focusing on shore power, platform integration and subsea tiebacks. steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable monitoring, shutdown and recovery model and evidence record for maintenance/state review.

steps.title: 監測停機與復原：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring, shutdown and recovery: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對維修與狀態複覈提出可反駁的監測停機與復原模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable monitoring, shutdown and recovery model and evidence record for maintenance/state review.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「監測停機與復原」模型，檢查維修與狀態複覈的兩個假想案例。在離線事件表比較停機、恢復及泄漏證據鏈。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分可用率受維護、完整性與供能限制；只做公開報告和假想事件分析。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous monitoring, shutdown and recovery model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving maintenance/state review. Compare downtime, recovery and containment evidence in an offline event table. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Maintenance, integrity and energy affect availability; analyze public reports/assumed events only." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 在離線事件表比較停機、恢復及泄漏證據鏈。
steps.observationEn: Compare downtime, recovery and containment evidence in an offline event table.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：恢復產量本身就證明所有安全狀態均正確。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Recovered production proves every safety state correct.
steps.check: 提交維修與狀態複覈的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for maintenance/state review.
